what: No head was fitted here. The models' own sentence rows were given the prior, the calibration and the page's combination with the kind phrases, with every setting chosen on the whole of `val`. These are the slots that can ship before any training photo exists.

kind_heads.name: summed species probabilities of the head `sentences`
the page's combination of kind phrases and the species list (rule `mix`, t_kind 100, w_kind 0.5; species head `sentences`)

kind_decision.tuned_number: the mean of the share right on the wildlife tuning photos and of the mean share right over the extra set's kinds

confidence.head: sentences
confidence.text: For the head `sentences`, the scale was set on the tuning photos (expected calibration error 0.204 there). A species is named when its probability is at least 0.28, the lowest level from which named species were right at least nine times in ten on the tuning photos; three species are offered when the first three together reach 0.45, set the same way. On the test photos a species is then named for 17.7% (16.6 to 18.9) of photos and that name is right for 89.6% (87.5 to 91.9) of them; three species are offered for 1.7% (1.4 to 2.1) and hold the right one for 83.6% (75.3 to 91.8); 80.6% (79.4 to 81.7) get a kind of eye only. These figures leave out the page's rule that names and offers must agree with the winning kind; the exported slot is scored with that rule.
